text:
Customer_42: Hi, we just have a serious billing issue. One API call apparently charged our card three times. request_id=rQw9-231.
Maria Gomez: omg, sorry to hear — can you paste the request body you sent (redact any PII)?
Customer_42: sent. here's the chat payload (redacted):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"charge $9.99 for order 987"}],
  "tool_call": {"name":"charge_customer","arguments": {"order_id":"987","amount":9.99}}
}
```
Customer_42: The API returned a 400 with body saying \"schema validation failed: missing transaction_id\" but our bank shows three charges. We only sent once.
Jake Park: Thanks — that implies our runtime retried the tool call despite a schema error. Can you give me the exact error payload and request id?
Customer_42: error body: `{ \"error\": {\"type\": \"tool_error\", \"code\": \"schema_validation\", \"details\": \"missing field transaction_id\"}, \"request_id\": \"rQw9-231\" }`
Olivia Chen: grabbing runtime logs for rQw9-231, snippet below:
```
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] REQ rQw9-231 -> dispatch tool charge_customer
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] TOOL charge_customer START args={order_id:987,amount:9.99}
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] TOOL charge_customer ERROR schema_validation missing transaction_id
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] RUNTIME retry policy: classify error -> transient -> retrying (attempt=1)
[2026-03-10T14:22:12Z] TOOL charge_customer START args={order_id:987,amount:9.99}
[2026-03-10T14:22:12Z] TOOL charge_customer SUCCESS charge_id=ch_A1
[2026-03-10T14:22:12Z] webhook -> payments provider processed ch_A1
[2026-03-10T14:22:13Z] TOOL charge_customer START args={order_id:987,amount:9.99}
[2026-03-10T14:22:13Z] TOOL charge_customer SUCCESS charge_id=ch_A2
[2026-03-10T14:22:13Z] runtime returning success to client
```
Olivia Chen: logs show a retry loop and multiple successful executions. runtime returned success after first success but retries continued due to how retry controller was implemented.
Sana Patel: billing: we received webhook events for ch_A1 and ch_A2 and processed both. Customer reports three charges — need to correlate with provider (could be another duplicate on provider side).
Maria Gomez: urgent: customer needs refund. We also need an engineering hotfix.
Jake Park: initial root cause: (A) our retry classifier treated schema_validation as a transient error, (B) charge_customer is non-idempotent but tool args didn't include a transaction_id, (C) runtime will continue retries even after first success in some race conditions.
LLM-ops-bot: Recommendation: require an explicit idempotency token for payment tools and/or reject calls that don't include transaction_id as a pre-dispatch validation. Also add X-Redwood-Idempotency header handling.
Jake Park: agree. short term: block automatic retries for any tool marked non-idempotent in tool metadata. Also add a pre-dispatch schema gate that returns 400 before attempting tool when required fields are missing.
Olivia Chen: PR opened to change retry classification: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/PR-489 (maps schema_validation/invalid_arguments -> permanent)
Olivia Chen: another PR to fix the retry controller so that once a tool execution returns success, remaining retry attempts are aborted: https://git.redwood/internal/runtime/PR-1023
Sana Patel: billing processed two refunds for duplicates (refund_tx=rf_7721 and rf_7722). Left one charge as valid (ch_A1). Emailed receipt to customer. Ticket BILL-1124 created.
Maria Gomez: customer message drafted: \"We're very sorry — our system retried a failed payment attempt and caused duplicate charges. We issued refunds for duplicate charges and are disabling retries for payment tools while we roll out a fix. We'll follow up when patch is live.\" :pray:
Customer_42: thanks for the quick help — please confirm once refunds are complete.
Sana Patel: refunds processed, customer emailed. We also flagged payment provider with case #PP-9902 to verify there wasn't an extra duplicate at their end.
Jake Park: longer-term plan:
- enforce idempotency token required for non-idempotent tools (transaction_id)
- add a dedupe layer at dispatch that uses explicit idempotency token and short TTL
- treat schema_validation and invalid_arguments as permanent errors (no retries)
- add telemetry: alert when retry_count > 0 for non-idempotent tools and when duplicate downstream webhooks spike
- runtime: ensure first success cancels in-flight retries and that we only return a single success event to client
Olivia Chen: temporary mitigation: deploying canary that disables retries for tools where metadata.non_idempotent==true to dedicated and private zones. Monitoring channel: #billing-alerts and #runtime-alerts.
Jake Park: UX change idea: when a tool schema error occurs, instead of blind retry, the assistant should respond with a structured assistant message asking the user to supply missing fields, e.g., \"I couldn't call charge_customer: missing transaction_id — please provide a transaction id or confirm you want to proceed\". Avoids side effects.
Maria Gomez: follow-ups: Olivia keep me posted on canary, Jake link PRs here once merged, Sana finalize refund and closure, I'll update the customer ticket.
LLM-ops-bot: Incident logged -> INC-2026-tool-retry-billing.
Maria Gomez: closing note to customer: \"Refunds issued, duplicate charges reversed. We've deployed a fix to stop retries on payment tools and are rolling additional idempotency checks. Sorry for the disruption.\" :white_check_mark:
